reviews.review:
I wouldn't pay full price but it goes on sale often and is worth the sale price.

The game has been out for a long time and is still missing some basic features.

No text chat? In a team based game.
Game still crashes a lot.
No way to rejoin a game if you crash or just don't load in for some reason.
No host migration.  If the host leaves your run just ends. 
Lots of "stuff" but clearly most of it is just junk filler.

Missed opportunity for APC missions, drop ship mission, power loader missions, Aliens staples.
Short campaign with limited replay value.   Left for dead came out ages ago and had a director feature that tried to mix the levels up.  There doesn't seem to be anything like that the mission, spawns, waves, are the same every time. 

The levels all look nice and are "different" but when you get down to it they are all still corridor shooters and play basically the same. 

I am not personally a fan of the Synths or of the Pathogen in Alien games.  I understand it is there for more variety but there is plenty of pure Alien variety that was left out.

The class system just doesn't feel "right."  Some of the classes are clearly powerhouses and others feel lack luster.   The Doc class specifically could use some work.  Personally I feel like a load out system would have fit better.  As it is now it feel more like an excuse to have you keep playing to level each class.  When just leveling and unlocking things you wanted and building abilities and perks for your play style would have been better.

Most of the kit items become non-viable after standard difficulty. Cryo or Elec mines + drone being the best for everyone to carry.  Dont bother saving anything else, just plop it down on the mission you are playing when you get them. 

Some sort of system, level, area, mode, where building fortifications, sealing vents, welding or cutting doors, ways to change the environment and adjust pathing would have been a nice addition. 

Pathing and AI, for the most part the AI is pretty good.  The spawns and pathing are predictable and easy to exploit.   Aliens will come out of vents 1 at a time and go to the exact same place one after another before starting their attacks.   Its like shooting fish in a barrel once you notice and learn the animation.  Could use some work for additional spawn points or clusters of aliens spawning/emerging at once. 

Horde mode just feels kinda tacked on and not fleshed out.  Nothing changes or nothing to do it just has more elites spawn the longer you go.  which becomes repetitive very quickly.

All in all its a fine horde/corridor shooter game that's worth the price if its on sale. But falls short of what it could have been and seems to be abandoned at this point with no updates.
This is the authentic Crackbarrel Shoot-a-thon experience.
